svg.text: HEIGHTS (unsurveyed): except in R05, the 2.959 m band and 3.188 m slab underside are derived from homeowner-stated HD-11 figures and assumed slab/finish thicknesses. R05 only: band 3.048 m and centre approximately 3.277 m are

homeowner-reported. The reported centre conflicts with the older slab estimate; actual slab and panel levels and their construction remain unmeasured. Bathrooms, utility, lobby and balcony levels are placeholders; opening heads are
assumed. Verify all levels on site.
Drawn south-up (not rotated): sheet-top = SOUTH (utility/washing), sheet-bottom = NORTH (entrance/balcony), sheet-left = EAST (kitchen/dining/living), sheet-right = WEST (bedrooms).

Compass: approximate homeowner north, recorded in the master (visualization_geometry.orientation): entrance/balcony/stairs face NORTH. Cardinal directions only — true bearing and magnetic declination are not surveyed.

† marks an opening that is assumed, a placeholder, centred-but-unmeasured, or (PN1) a built niche whose size is unmeasured. Window and door positions are modelled plan positions, not site verified; sills and heads are assumptions.

Held items (red dashed) are not approved layouts. The 2.939 m children’s curtain top is an assumed HD-11 drawing level, not measured hardware. Living, master and children’s concealed curtain pockets need two tracks (sheer + blackout,
HD-14); their clear sizes are unverified.

Dimensions in metres unless marked mm. Wall names are compass directions; the small sheet tags (e.g. master-s) are only drawing IDs. Items without a height in the master are shown as footprints below the floor line.
REVIEW DRAFT · read-only drawing from the canonical master · not a construction release · unmeasured levels and sizes marked
